name: Maine
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. Maine's extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward): Kittery and the Isles of Shoals set the south edge, West Quoddy Head the east edge, the St. John valley the north edge. Open ocean beyond those points is trimmed; the Gulf of Maine south-east of the coast inside the box cannot be trimmed with a rectangle, and the box also takes in parts of New Brunswick and Quebec. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-me.
